tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, table rows, modals, menus, toasts, kanban columns.

tokens.name: surface-field
tokens.usage: Background of inputs, dropdown triggers and date boxes. View-mode fields use this too: never gray them out.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Modal footer, sub navigation bar in dark, date-picker preset sidebar, empty calendar days.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, card outline, column lines in table rows. Decorative: carries no meaning alone.

tokens.name: border-field
tokens.usage: Resting border of inputs, dropdowns, checkboxes and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 against surface in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11); hover and focus switch to border-field-hover or focus-ring.

tokens.name: border-field-hover
tokens.usage: Field border on hover.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-field and surface-muted.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels, secondary lines, table header text outside the gradient, placeholders' darker sibling. On bg, surface and surface-muted.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled text only. Raised on 2026-11-21 to meet WCAG 4.5:1 on surface in both themes. Never for content.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected view-switcher segment, selected calendar day, selected preset, focus accents. Solid only: never a gradient. Fixed for now: per-tenant brand color is a future feature; when it arrives only brand and its derivatives change.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover. Darker than brand in both themes so on-brand text keeps 4.5:1.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: The brand colour used as text or a link on bg and surface. Same as brand in light; lighter in dark so it keeps 4.5:1. Use brand for fills and brand-text for text and links.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Active tab and sub-nav text with its 2px underline, sparklines, progress fill, links. On surface and bg.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected menu item, date-range band between start and end, drop placeholder fill, stage chip.

tokens.name: on-brand-soft
tokens.usage: Text on brand-soft.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Neutral tags, count pills, progress and chart tracks, hover fill of menu rows.

tokens.name: on-neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-soft.

tokens.name: nav-start
tokens.usage: Start of the 120deg gradient. The gradient is used ONLY on the top navigation bar, table header and calendar weekday header.

tokens.name: nav-end
tokens.usage: End of the 120deg gradient (nav-start to nav-end).

tokens.name: on-nav
tokens.usage: Active item text and icons on the gradient.

tokens.name: on-nav-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive nav items on the gradient.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus color. Fields: border takes focus-ring plus a 3px focus-halo. Buttons: solid 3px focus-halo-strong. This is the only focus definition.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: 3px ring around a focused field or dropdown (box-shadow 0 0 0 3px).

tokens.name: focus-halo-strong
tokens.usage: Solid 3px ring around a focused button, switch, checkbox or chip. Same value as focus-ring (6.51:1 light, 8.32:1 dark on surface) so the focus indicator meets 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11, 2.4.7).

tokens.name: danger-halo
tokens.usage: 2px ring around a field in error.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Filled badge and toast icon for success; due status 'upcoming'; 'in stock'.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on success. Always dark, never white.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Filled badge for pending; due status 'today'; 'low stock'.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Filled badge for overdue, delete button fill, notification counter; due status 'overdue'; 'out of stock'.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on danger.

tokens.name: status-none
tokens.usage: Kanban column bar and timeline dot when there is no due date or the column is empty.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: The success colour used as text or an icon (positive delta, valid-field message, check glyph). Keeps 4.5:1 on surface, bg, row-hover, surface-muted, neutral-soft and success-soft in both themes. Use success for fills and success-text for text and icons.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: The warning colour used as text or an icon (warning message under a field, unsaved-changes label, rating star, alert glyph). Keeps 4.5:1 on surface, bg, row-hover, surface-muted and neutral-soft in both themes. Use warning for fills and warning-text for text and icons; a soft warning chip is bg-neutral-soft with warning-text.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: The danger colour used as text or an icon (validation error message, required asterisk, destructive menu item, error glyph). Keeps 4.5:1 on surface, bg, row-hover, surface-muted, neutral-soft and danger-soft in both themes. Use danger for fills and danger-text for text and icons.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of a field in error, with a 2px ring of the same color at 15%.
